title: EAP result message transport procedure initiation by the network

entities.name: EAP result message transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to transport EAP result messages (EAP-success or EAP-failure) to the UE using AUTHENTICATION RESULT or AUTHENTICATION REJECT messages.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESULT message
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE containing EAP-success or EAP-failure result in the EAP message IE.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT message
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE containing EAP-failure result in the EAP message IE.

entities.name: EAP message IE
entities.description: Information element that carries EAP-success or EAP-failure messages in AUTHENTICATION RESULT and AUTHENTICATION REJECT messages.

entities.name: ngKSI IE
entities.description: Information element that carries the ngKSI value selected during authentication procedures.

entities.name: EAP-success message
entities.description: EAP message indicating successful authentication, carried in EAP message IE of AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.

entities.name: EAP-failure message
entities.description: EAP message indicating authentication failure, carried in EAP message IE of AUTHENTICATION RESULT or AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that creates and sends authentication messages to the UE.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives and processes authentication messages from the AMF.

relations.description: The EAP result message transport procedure includes sending AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.
The EAP result message transport procedure includes sending AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.
AUTHENTICATION RESULT message contains EAP message IE.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message contains EAP message IE.
AUTHENTICATION RESULT message contains ngKSI IE.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message contains ngKSI IE.
EAP message IE may contain EAP-success message in AUTHENTICATION RESULT.
EAP message IE may contain EAP-failure message in AUTHENTICATION RESULT or AUTHENTICATION REJECT.
AMF creates and sends AUTHENTICATION RESULT message to UE.
AMF creates and sends AUTHENTICATION REJECT message to UE.
UE receives and processes AUTHENTICATION RESULT message with EAP message IE.
UE receives and processes AUTHENTICATION REJECT message with EAP message IE.
